newsitem.title: USA: Party City Q3 same sales up 17.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Party City Q3 same sales up 17.4 pct.

text.p: Party City Corp said Thursday same-store sales for its company-owned stores increased 17.4 percent in the third quarter from the year-ago period.

Total revenues for the period ending September 30 increased 111 percent to $9.9 million, compared with $4.7 million for the year-ago quarter. Sales grew 142 percent to $7.5 million, up from $3.1 million a year ago, the party supply retailer said.
It said same-store sales for franchise stores increased 10.8 percent for the quarter.
